scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The result is proved by exact rank-one eigenvalue algebra and the Sherman--Morrison identity. The admissibility condition is stated explicitly rather than inferred, and the source-specific corollary is an exact symbolic identity. No numerical experiment or finite enumeration is used as proof.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: The aligned update condition is essential, and post-transfer inverse positivity is not automatic. No claim is made for arbitrary rank-one updates, higher-rank new-production matrices, or a unique biological interpretation of the resulting reproduction number.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Finite-dimensional regular splittings with a nonnegative rank-one matrix and aligned nonnegative rank-one transfers; plus an exact comparison of the two displayed reproduction-number formulas in Johnston--Cupons Example 3.12.

title: Aligned rank-one transfers contract regular-splitting reproduction numbers toward one
